items.heading: Most Students Shopping Most Students
items.text: Most Students Shopping Most Students Most Students Shopping Most students shopping for an education loan for study abroad India start by comparing interest rates across a few homepages. That comparison is close to useless on its own, because the rate a lender advertises usually applies to a specific product tier, a secured loan, a top university, or a high-income co-applicant, that may not match your actual situation. The real first question is structural: are you offering collateral or not, and does your target university even qualify for the loan type you want.

items.heading: Three Broad Lender Categories Fund
items.text: Three broad lender categories fund study abroad education in India, and each one solves a different problem for a different kind of applicant.
